name: Missing Episode Marker
description: Checks every series Sonarr manages for monitored episodes without a file and burns a configurable "missing episodes" banner into the series and season posters, so every client (including Swiftfin, Infuse and TV apps) shows it. Supports a grace period for ongoing shows, special-episode rules, per-series overrides and anime filler handling.
overview: Marks TV shows and seasons that are missing episodes, using Sonarr.

versions.changelog: Markers come back within seconds when Jellyfin replaces a poster, and a series is rechecked as soon as episodes are added or removed. Settings page reorganized into tabs with search, multi-select rules, a specials picker and help texts. Grace period in days/weeks/months/years, schedule setting, progress bar with time estimate, optional menu entry, poster status in the report, and a plugin image.
